notes.title: New RPG game Parallel
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome to the Parallel World[/b][/h1]

If you like the game, add it to your [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388350/Parallel/]Steam Wishlist[/url][/b]

[i]Parallel is a first-person RPG adventure game, you will explore a parallel world with a new civilization. Each player will go through different environments, from mysticism, paradise to claustrophobic and destruction scenes.[/i]

[previewyoutube=751CCnx7YT0;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]If you like to explore, unravel mysteries, solve puzzles, learn about a new world, make your own choices, this game is made for you.
[/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388350/Parallel/][img]https://cdnb.artstation.com/p/assets/images/images/029/391/199/large/rodrigo-banzato-screenshots5.jpg?1597386158[/img][/url]

[i]The player can experience many types of emotions. It all depends on what he wants to do in the game. With charismatic characters and specific scenes, this game brings a lot of immersion. Immersion is definitely the strongest part of this game, moving to mystical and very attractive moments.[/i] 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388350/Parallel/][img]https://cdna.artstation.com/p/assets/images/images/029/391/124/large/rodrigo-banzato-parallel-joker-imagem19.jpg?1597438001[/img][/url]

[i]I am working really hard on this game, with a lot passion and love. I hope I can bring the best game experience possible for you. Cordially, [url=https://www.artstation.com/rodrigobanzato]Rodrigo Banzato[/url][/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388350/Parallel/][img]https://cdnb.artstation.com/p/assets/images/images/029/391/261/large/rodrigo-banzato-parallel-rpg-imagem9-vertical.jpg?1597386361[/img][/url]
[i]
If you want to know more about this game, stay tuned to our newsletter and other social networks, check the official website[/i] [url=http://www.parallel-game.com]www.parallel-game.com[/url]

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
Hello guys, let's take a look to the news.  Patch 1.0 is out.  Thanks for all the support.  As you may know, we are a very, very small team with Zero resources, but we're focused on hear your feedback which will help us a lot on the improvements for our game.

1 - When players get stuck behind the stairs (fixed)
2 - The fake death with the octopus corrupting your progress (fixed)
3 - Corrupt broken glass with the mutant (fixed)
4 - Improved the laser mode explosion of the enemies (its more flashy)
5 - You don't lose your items anymore on the card room
6 - You now can kill the radiation mutated with the right ammo and amount of shoots, and you don't stay stuck with a black screen when you die
7 - Fixed some texts and sounds
8 - The mutated on the embryo room don't hide anymore
9 - An invisible collision was corrected on the embryo room
10 - The collision on the left in the embryo room now is fixed

[i]We will keep working on the bugs and improvements. Thanks for playing the game and have fun.[/i]

Don't forget, if you like our game, support us on our [url=http://www.shadowsofkepler.com]Official Site[/url]
